claims.title: Avoiding collisions is not sufficient for solving the maze
claims.statement: Astra + Codex on medium hex MIRROR-043 had zero collisions through decision499, yet reached the500-decision cap after visiting206/331cells. All38collisions occurred in its final89-action sequence.
claims.qualification: One recorded episode. This describes behavior, not whether the model internally recognized all walls correctly.

claims.title: More decisions need not mean more physical exploration
claims.statement: On two equally sized medium hex maps, Astra used500decisions and1078actions in the capped case, versus246decisions and1685actions in the successful case. Coverage was206versus264cells; new-cell yield was0.410versus1.069cells per decision.
claims.qualification: Different seeds; does not isolate an effect of batching or memory. Shows why decisions, actions and coverage should be reported separately.

claims.title: Long coverage plateaus are visible in the action record
claims.statement: The Seed2.1Pro API run on easy hex MIRROR-043 discovered only4/127cells and added no new cell during decisions5–200:196consecutive decisions. Astra medium hex043 had a41-decision plateau at38cells (121–161).
claims.qualification: A plateau may include turning, revisiting or unsuccessful movement. It is not an observation of hidden reasoning or a proof that memory alone caused failure.

claims.title: End-of-budget sequences can dominate the collision statistic
claims.statement: Across the four GPT-6.1Sol API runs,966of1036collisions (93.2%) occurred in the final decision of the three capped runs. Reporting only aggregate collisions would hide the mostly collision-light prefixes.
claims.qualification: This concentration is measured after the fact. Do not call a collision count a pure perception metric.

claims.title: The default hex challenge is also a larger challenge
claims.statement: Easy maps contain49square cells versus127hex cells (2.59times as many); medium maps contain121versus331 (2.74times). The existing square/hex success contrast therefore combines topology, scale, turns and individual maze layout.
claims.qualification: A matched-cell-count or matched-graph-distance model study would be needed to isolate topology.

claims.title: The planning budget admits a constructive ideal-observer solution
claims.statement: With complete delivery of new-cell scans, a perfect local observer with exact memory on these tree mazes can backtrack on known paths, enter one new cell, and scan its directions in one batch. This conservative DFS policy needs at mostNdecisions:49/127on easy maps and121/331on medium maps, below their respective200/500caps.
claims.qualification: Algorithmic reference with ideal sensing, identity tracking and full new-cell scan delivery; not measured human performance or an optimal visual policy. Scan rotations are charged. A large batch may be pruned by model clients, so this bound is not a verified transport-matched guarantee.

definitions.planning_decision: One accepted public final response; invalid sequence counts as one decision and one penalty
definitions.new_cell: Physical cell ID not previously visited in the same episode, including all within-sequence intermediate states
definitions.stall: Consecutive decisions with zero newly visited cells, excluding the decision that initially established that coverage level
definitions.coverage: Unique visited cells / all cells; starting cell included
definitions.rotation_only: Nonempty executed sequence containing only left/right
definitions.complete_rotation_scan: Rotation-only sequence with at least H turns and net heading change0modH
definitions.contains_full_rotation_scan: Executed sequence contains H consecutive same-direction rotations, possibly mixed with other actions
definitions.repeated_forward_fraction: 1-(visited_cells-1)/successful_forward_moves. Necessary backtracking can count here; this is not a waste label.
definitions.repeat_blocked_pose: A collision at a physical (cell,heading) already blocked earlier in the same episode; ground-truth review only
definitions.reviewer_goal_distance: Shortest physical passage distance from the end-of-round cell to the hidden goal; never a model input

causal_limitations: Four fixed cases per model/configuration, no repeated sampling
Native prompts, state management, defaults and sources are not matched to the public-text API arm
Astra medium cases have different geometry and500instead of200planning decisions; do not pool their pass rates
Success curves are stopped at goal; cap outcomes are right-censored
